name: studentpath-end-to-end-v1
scope: End-to-end questions over the ten collected ISD sources (data/sources_manifest_v1.json), asked through the Gateway. Not legal advice.
provenance: Expected answers come only from data/qa_gate_10_v1.json. No other immigration facts were added. Cases marked needs_team_review must be checked against the collected snapshots before results are reported.
global_checks: an answered response cites at least one source
answered/degraded cases retrieve an expected source in the top 5 passages
required_terms present and forbidden_terms absent (case-insensitive; weak signal, review answers manually)

cases.question: How long after notification of their degree award must an otherwise eligible Stamp 2 holder apply for the Third Level Graduate Programme?
cases.expected_answer: Within six months of written notification of the award, while holding a current Stamp 2 permission and up-to-date registration card.

cases.question: Can a graduate with Stamp 1G permission be self-employed or operate a business?
cases.expected_answer: No. Graduate Stamp 1G permits full-time employment subject to law but not self-employment or operating a business.

cases.question: How early may someone apply to renew their IRP, and can they submit while outside Ireland?
cases.expected_answer: Up to 12 weeks before expiry; the applicant must be physically present in Ireland. Stamp 2 students must also wait until their course starts.

cases.question: Which core documents are listed for a Stamp 2 to graduate Stamp 1G renewal, and does ordinary travel insurance suffice?
cases.expected_answer: Passport biographical page, both sides of current IRP card, proof of successful completion of third-level course, and proof of private medical insurance. Travel insurance is not sufficient for renewal.
cases.notes: Sunmin's run (2026-11-16): correct evidence collected but ranked 67th, outside the top 5. Check ranking and whether the renewal column stays with its heading after chunking.

cases.question: Can a graduate apply online to change their registration category from Stamp 2 to Stamp 1G?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, in the listed circumstances, provided the necessary supporting documents are uploaded. Renewals and stamp changes are generally online.

cases.question: What attendance level and final assessment are required for a full-time English-language student on Stamp 2?
cases.expected_answer: At least 85% class attendance and a recognised exam at the end of the English-language programme.

cases.question: What should a graduate do if their Stamp 1G permission ends and they have not secured an employment permit or another immigration permission?
cases.expected_answer: They are expected to leave Ireland if they do not get an employment permit or otherwise apply for and qualify for another permission before Stamp 1G ends.

cases.question: When must a newly arrived non-EU/EEA/UK/Swiss resident intending to stay longer than 90 days register, and where does initial registration take place?
cases.expected_answer: Registration is required within 90 days of arrival. First-time registration in the Republic of Ireland is handled by ISD at Burgh Quay in Dublin following an appointment.

cases.question: For a non-visa-required student on a course leading to a stay longer than eight months, how much access to funds does ISD require?
cases.expected_answer: €10,000 accessible funds, in addition to applicable course-fee requirements.
cases.notes: Sunmin proposes removing the course-fee clause from the expected answer because the cited section applies to a different group. Pending team confirmation; the required term avoids it.

cases.question: Does submitting an application to change an immigration stamp automatically extend the applicant’s existing permission?
cases.expected_answer: No. The page states that submitting an application does not extend current permission; the current permission must still be valid.
